events.title: Announcing Kinmoku's Next Game: 'Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart'
events.summary: 🖤🩶 Today is International Asexuality Day! 🤍💜To celebrate, I'm happy to share my next game Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart which invites you to talk freely with a-spec characters, understand their journeys and make lasting connections. This short, insightful narrative experience will be coming soon to Steam for PC, Mac, Linux and Steam Deck!Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart welcomes you into an Ace and Aro meetup, which just so happens to be located in a barcade!
